description: Get raw cash balances: USDT available plus the three frozen partitions (frozen = spot orders, frozenPm = PM, frozenFutures = futures margin). Optionally include one coin asset. Paper trading only (virtual mUSD). Fills follow paper_execution_v1 with a disclosed execution cost; see executionModel in quote/trade results.

agentTrace.description: Optional private trace metadata stored in the caller's ledger.

decisionId.description: Agent decision id for quote/write attribution.

rationaleSummary.description: Optional concise rationale summary. Do not include chain-of-thought, secrets, or account identity.

strategyLabel.description: Short strategy label, self-reported by the caller.

coinId.description: Coin UCID (e.g. "1" = BTC) to also return that asset.
